test_cases.description: Verify that any agentspec error satisfies the AgentSpecError interface and is matchable via errors.As, returning a non-empty Category() string.
preconditions: agentspec package is compiled and importable
a concrete agentspec error value (e.g. ConfigError) is available
test_cases.expected: errors.As(err, &target) returns true; target.Category() returns a non-empty string
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
var target AgentSpecError
err := newConfigError("test")
assert errors.As(err, &target) == true
assert len(target.Category()) > 0

test_cases.description: Verify that ConfigError.Category() returns exactly the string "config" and satisfies the AgentSpecError interface.
test_cases.expected: errors.As(err, &target) is true; target.Category() == "config"
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
var target AgentSpecError
err := newConfigError("invalid toml")
assert errors.As(err, &target) == true
assert target.Category() == "config"

test_cases.description: Verify that CampaignError.Category() returns exactly the string "campaign" and satisfies the AgentSpecError interface.
test_cases.expected: errors.As(err, &target) is true; target.Category() == "campaign"
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
var target AgentSpecError
err := newCampaignError("duplicate path")
assert errors.As(err, &target) == true
assert target.Category() == "campaign"

test_cases.description: Verify that SessionError.Category() returns exactly the string "state" and satisfies the AgentSpecError interface.
test_cases.expected: errors.As(err, &target) is true; target.Category() == "state"
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
var target AgentSpecError
err := newSessionError("illegal transition")
assert errors.As(err, &target) == true
assert target.Category() == "state"

test_cases.description: Verify that AgentError carries Detail, ErrorCategory, Retryable, HTTPStatus fields, implements Unwrap() returning the original error, and satisfies AgentSpecError.
test_cases.input: wrapped := errors.New("original"); err := &AgentError{Detail: "rate limited", ErrorCategory: "rate_limit", Retryable: true, HTTPStatus: ptr(429), cause: wrapped}
test_cases.expected: errors.As(err, &target) is true; errors.Unwrap(err) == wrapped; err.Detail == "rate limited"; err.ErrorCategory == "rate_limit"; err.Retryable == true; *err.HTTPStatus == 429
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode:
wrapped := errors.New("original")
err := newAgentError("rate limited", "rate_limit", true, ptr(429), wrapped)
var target AgentSpecError
assert errors.As(err, &target) == true
assert errors.Unwrap(err) == wrapped
assert err.Detail == "rate limited"
assert err.ErrorCategory == "rate_limit"
assert err.Retryable == true
assert *err.HTTPStatus == 429

test_cases.description: Verify that LoadConfig reads the first config.toml found in .specs/ relative to cwd, parses [model] and [provider] sections, and silently ignores unknown sections.
preconditions: a temporary directory is created as the working directory

assert err == nil
assert cfg.Model == "FAST"

assert cfg.VertexProject == "proj"

test_cases.description: Verify that when AF_SPEC_MODEL is set to a non-empty value, LoadConfig overrides the Model field from the config file with the environment variable value.
preconditions: a temporary directory is created as the working directory

test_cases.description: Verify that LoadConfig returns a ConfigError when the config.toml file is a symlink (resolved path differs from original path).

property_tests.description: For any error value returned by any agentspec function, errors.As to AgentSpecError succeeds and Category() returns a non-empty string.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample errors from all agentspec error constructors: newConfigError, newCampaignError, newSessionError, newAgentError with varied parameters; also wrap them with fmt.Errorf("%w", err)
property_tests.invariant_check: for each sampled err: assert errors.As(err, &target) == true; assert len(target.Category()) > 0

property_tests.description: For any call to LoadConfig when AF_SPEC_MODEL is set to a non-empty string, the returned AgentSpecConfig.Model always equals the AF_SPEC_MODEL value regardless of config file contents.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random non-empty strings for AF_SPEC_MODEL (alphanumeric, 1-50 chars); vary config.toml presence (absent, present with different model values, present with invalid model key); run LoadConfig in a temp directory for each combination
property_tests.invariant_check: cfg, err := LoadConfig(); assert err == nil OR errors.As(err, &ConfigError{}); if err == nil { assert cfg.Model == os.Getenv("AF_SPEC_MODEL") }

property_tests.description: For any call to LoadConfig when both .specs/config.toml and ~/.specs/config.toml exist, the returned config is populated solely from the local file.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random model strings for local and global config files (ensuring they differ); create both files in temp directories; call LoadConfig with cwd set to the temp directory
property_tests.invariant_check: cfg, err := LoadConfig(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Model == localModelValue; assert cfg.Model != globalModelValue

property_tests.description: For any file write operation in agentspec, the target path either contains complete new content or pre-existing content after the operation completes or fails; no partial file is observable.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Inject filesystem faults at random points during atomic writes (before rename, during write, after write but before rename) for campaign.yaml, prd.md, and _session.json; use a fault-injection wrapper around os.Rename and os.WriteFile
property_tests.invariant_check: after each write attempt (success or failure): content := readFile(targetPath); assert isCompleteValidContent(content) OR content == preExistingContent; assert noTempFilesMatchingPattern(dir, "*.tmp*")

property_tests.description: For any successful state transition on a SpecSession, _session.json reflects the new state; if the write fails, the in-memory state is reverted to match the pre-transition state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Create sessions in StateAssessing or StateRefining; call AcceptPRD with and without injected write failures; sample both success and failure scenarios
property_tests.invariant_check: if AcceptPRD returns nil: assert session.State() == StatePRDAccepted AND parseJSON(readFile("_session.json"))["state"] == "prd_accepted"; if AcceptPRD returns error: assert session.State() == preTransitionState AND parseJSON(readFile("_session.json"))["state"] == preTransitionStateStr

property_tests.description: AcceptPRD returns nil if and only if the pre-call state was StateAssessing or StateRefining; otherwise it returns a SessionError and the state is unchanged.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample all SessionState values (StateInit, StateAssessing, StateRefining, StatePRDAccepted, StateGenerating, StateGenerated) by constructing sessions with each state via direct JSON manipulation of _session.json; call AcceptPRD on each
property_tests.invariant_check: if preState in {StateAssessing, StateRefining}: assert AcceptPRD() == nil AND session.State() == StatePRDAccepted; else: assert errors.As(AcceptPRD(), &SessionError{}) == true AND session.State() == preState

property_tests.description: For any call to InlineRefs with any schema map where all referenced definitions exist in $defs, the returned map contains no $ref or $defs keys at any nesting level.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random JSON Schema maps with varying depths (1-5 levels), random numbers of $defs entries (0-10), and random $ref references pointing to existing $defs; also generate schemas with no $refs
property_tests.invariant_check: result := InlineRefs(schema); assert NOT deepContainsKey(result, "$ref"); assert NOT containsKey(result, "$defs")

property_tests.description: For any call to CleanSchema with any schema map containing description fields, every description field present in the input is present in the output at the same nesting path.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random JSON Schema maps with description fields at varying nesting depths (1-5 levels), mixed with title, default, and $schema fields; record all description field paths before calling CleanSchema
property_tests.invariant_check: descPaths := collectDescriptionPaths(schema); result := CleanSchema(schema); for each path in descPaths: assert getAtPath(result, path) == getAtPath(schema, path)

property_tests.description: For any sequence of calls to Campaign.NewSpec on the same campaign, each new spec directory's numeric prefix is strictly greater than the maximum prefix among all existing active and archived spec directories.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Create a campaign; call NewSpec N times (N sampled from 1-10) with random valid spec names; after each call, scan both active and archive directories to collect all numeric prefixes
property_tests.invariant_check: after each NewSpec call: allPrefixes := collectAllPrefixes(campaignDir, archiveDir); newPrefix := prefixOf(newSpecDir); assert newPrefix == max(allPrefixes excluding newPrefix) + 1

property_tests.description: For any SpecSession created by CreateSession, ResumeSession returns a SpecSession with identical state, mode, prd_path, assessment_history, qa_exchanges, generated_artifacts, and last_error fields.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate random valid SpecSession parameters: specDir (temp dir), mode (sampled from ["standard", "fast"]), source (random path string); call CreateSession then immediately ResumeSession; also test after simulated process restart by re-reading from disk
property_tests.invariant_check: original, _ := CreateSession(specDir, mode, source); resumed, _ := ResumeSession(specDir); assert resumed.State() == original.State(); assert resumed.mode == original.mode; assert resumed.prdPath == original.prdPath; assert deepEqual(resumed.assessmentHistory, original.assessmentHistory); assert deepEqual(resumed.qaExchanges, original.qaExchanges); assert deepEqual(resumed.generatedArtifacts, original.generatedArtifacts)

smoke_tests.trigger: Create a SpecSession with a specDir containing only requirements.json (missing test_spec.json and tasks.json), then call session.Validate()
mockable: afspec.LoadSpec (expected to fail due to missing artifacts)
expected_effects: Validate() returns (SessionValidationResult, nil) with no error from Validate itself
SessionValidationResult.Valid == false
SessionValidationResult.SchemaErrors or IntegrityErrors contains entries describing the missing artifacts
validation does not panic or return a non-nil error from Validate()

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end smoke test: open an existing campaign and list its specs sorted by numeric prefix, excluding archive/.
smoke_tests.trigger: Create a campaign directory with campaign.yaml and subdirectories 03_gamma, 01_alpha, 02_beta, archive/05_old; call OpenCampaign then Campaign.Specs()
expected_effects: OpenCampaign returns (*Campaign, nil) with Metadata.Name populated from campaign.yaml
Campaign.Specs() returns (["01_alpha", "02_beta", "03_gamma"], nil)
archive/ is not included in the returned slice
results are sorted ascending by numeric prefix
